timeline: Act I — Mid-Morning Quay Interception before the Midday Tide-Gate

character.name: Corin Hale
character.archetype: Junior Harbor Excise Clerk & Field Auditor

key_evidence.name: Crimson Wax Stamp Sample
key_evidence.location: Corin's leather satchel (matched to Vesper yard slip)

open_threads: Deliver the Cinder Ledger, pitch-arson proof, and forged bond-slip to Inspector Bren before the midday Tide-Gate opens.
Identify who authorized the #P7-088 Excise counter-initial and why the crimson-stamped crates were bound for Maren Vesper's vaults.
Break clear of Maren Vesper's factor-guards and Captain Kestrel's Merrow crew at the Counting House Gate.
Follow up on the frightened deckhand who sold lamp-tallow near The Lantern Quay.

offered_choices.text: Hold your ground at the Counting House Gate and demand both Maren Vesper and Captain Kestrel put their salvage claims in writing before Inspector Bren.
Tuck the Cinder Ledger tight under your oilskin and sprint down the Ferry Steps onto a skiff bound for Pier Seven and Watch-Sergeant Orin's boom watch. [Cost: 2C]
Play House Merrow against House Vesper: offer Captain Kestrel proof of pine-pitch arson if her crew clears a path past Maren Vesper's guards.
Bluff Maren Vesper quietly—claim Inspector Bren already holds a copy of the #P7-088 counter-initial and ask what House Vesper offers to settle before noon.
